## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `connector_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the connector.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the connector was created.
- `description` (String) Optional description of the connector.
- `enablement_status` (String) The enablement status of the connector.
- `enablement_status_reason` (String) Reason for the current enablement status, if applicable.
- `health` (Attributes) Health status of the connector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health))

- `provider_name` (String) The cloud provider for this connector.
